rule: rewrite, paraphrase or "fix" pinned strings — preserve spelling, capitalisation and punctuation exactly
trigger: copy was "improved" or typo-fixed in a fidelity clone

rule: trace, regenerate, typeset or approximate a supplied logo — use its exact path data
trigger: logo redrawn from a screenshot instead of the supplied SVG

rule: substitute a specified font family for a look-alike
trigger: font swapped for a more common family and the metrics drifted

rule: let the browser synthesise bold or italic — ship real files and set font-synthesis: none
trigger: synthetic bold widened the headline and broke line breaks

rule: alter escaping, underscores or path segments of a pinned asset URL
trigger: a rewritten URL 404'd and the image silently disappeared

rule: substitute a "similar" video or image for the pinned source
trigger: a stock clip replaced the specified one

rule: add an overlay or scratch canvas instead of implementing the specified scrub
trigger: a recorded effect was faked with an overlay

rule: add a header, hero, cards, forms or extra copy because the layout "looks empty"
trigger: invented blocks changed the composition

rule: show the confirmed brand name, logo or domain when the brief is de-branded
trigger: brand recovered from metadata was printed on the page

rule: publish or deploy a build that was asked to stay local
trigger: a keep-it-local build was pushed to a public URL

rule: rely on the capped whole-page inventory to prove text does or does not exist — do a dedicated subtree extraction
trigger: the 400-element cap missed the hero DOM because its text was baked into banner images with load-bearing alt

rule: run ad-hoc Playwright scripts from outside scripts/ — ESM resolves packages from the script path, not cwd
trigger: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: cannot find package playwright from a TEMP script

rule: pass bracketed JS through node -e in PowerShell — write a temp .mjs and node --check it
trigger: PowerShell ate the regex/brackets and the probe ran on a mangled string

rule: park a forever-promise inside page.evaluate — sample the DOM from Node in a bounded loop
trigger: an autoplay probe hung the shell twice until timeout

rule: ship a check type that accepts only one coordinate spelling — support x/left and y/top aliases
trigger: boundingBox check rejected prop y and produced 4 phantom failures

rule: start the dev server without preflighting a free port
trigger: port 3000 was already taken by an unrelated process

rule: let a pagination row stretch — it is width:fit-content with margin-inline:auto
trigger: measured content boxes of 88/104/136px, never full width

rule: infer temporal behaviour from structure checks — use the autoplay probe and budget ~30s of sampling
trigger: auto cycle measured 5.65s hold-5.0s + 0.6s transition, seamless wrap at ~28s

rule: report success after DOM checks with no visual comparison
trigger: a green DOM run shipped a grey-gradient placeholder hero

rule: replace brand art with a flat rectangle — rebuild the block as DOM with the same composition and mask what remains
trigger: a flat placeholder lost the whole hero composition

rule: diff whole pages — capture the same selector on both sides at the same viewport widths
trigger: full-page screenshots can never align (different page furniture)

rule: parse PNGs with pngjs — use jimp; odiff's decoder reads files pngjs rejects
trigger: "unrecognised content at end of stream" on Playwright element screenshots

rule: trust a single diff scorer — fall back to pixelmatch and still emit diff% plus a bbox
trigger: odiff's server intermittently threw reading 'map' on successive comparisons

rule: anchor a component shot to a loose selector — prefer a stable child/ancestor and verify the shot dimensions first
trigger: main > div silently captured the whole page or a 0×80 header strip

rule: keep a diff pair whose selector has no stable non-zero box — drop it and mask the region
trigger: a 0-width wrapper kept failing while its children painted full width

rule: put commas inside comma-separated CLI sub-values — use ;; between entries or a JSON file
trigger: selector lists split at the wrong comma

rule: emit a colour pair without checking contrast on every surface it can sit on
trigger: muted text passed on surface and failed 4.4:1 on surface-alt (axe caught 6 nodes)

rule: emit var(--x) without defining --x — a missing custom property kills the whole declaration
trigger: --font-fallback was referenced by every font stack and never declared

rule: fit a fluid value across its own clamp — fit the interior samples and clamp to the measured min/max
trigger: a clamp(48px,10vw,140px) page came out as clamp(76.8px, calc(5.46px + 9.369vw), 140px)

rule: assume BOM-free, CRLF-free input — strip a UTF-8 BOM before parsing JSON
trigger: a spec.json saved by Notepad parsed as null and every downstream check was skipped

rule: pipe a long-running node process into Select-Object -First N in PowerShell — it stops the pipeline and kills the process mid-run
trigger: extract.mjs died after writing inventory ndjson and never wrote inventory.json, because the command ended in | Select-Object -First 3

rule: hotlink Google Fonts or a CDN in a build that must stay local — download the woff2 with assets.mjs fonts-local and ship the licence
trigger: a keep-it-local build still made third-party font requests; noRequest/budgets caught it

rule: print, commit or pass an API token on the command line — read it from ~/.fidelity.json / env and log only ok|status
trigger: a Figma and a Google Fonts key were pasted into chat and had to be treated as exposed

rule: treat --out as a directory when it is one — appending the filename only when the argument is not an existing dir
trigger: judge.mjs call --out judge threw EISDIR because it opened the directory as the verdict file

rule: normalize names coming from an external judge before matching (strip a trailing @width)
trigger: the model answered hero@390 as both name and width and verify rejected a correct verdict as an invented region

rule: figma.com/files is the dashboard and carries no file key — a pull needs figma.com/design/<key>/...
trigger: a dashboard URL was passed to figma.mjs pull and produced a confusing API 404
